note: 10 customer questions for session 02. Each answer key was worked out by hand from data/policies/ and data/catalog-export.csv. 'must' facts are needed for full marks; 'must_not' is a wrong claim that caps the score at 0. 'kind': lookup = one fact from one place, multi = policy plus catalog, math = arithmetic on top of that.

questions.question: I bought the Everyday Cookware Bundle two weeks ago. I use the two frying pans but I've never used the 3 quart saucepan. Can I send back just the saucepan, and how much would I get back?
must: Yes, one piece of a bundle can be returned (unused, within 30 days of delivery)
The saucepan's share of the bundle price is $51.25 (59 x 119 / 137)
A $7.95 return label fee is deducted for a change-of-mind return, so the refund is $43.30 (the fee is waived for Pantry Club Gold members)
questions.must_not: Says the refund is the saucepan's full list price of $59, or that part of a bundle can't be returned

questions.question: How much would shipping be if I order the 9 quart enameled cast iron Dutch oven to my home in Honolulu? And can I get it in two days?
must: Standard shipping is free because the item is over $75
A $20 heavy-item surcharge applies to this Dutch oven (KT-2027) and a $20 Alaska/Hawaii fee applies, so $40 in total
Expedited (2-day) shipping is not available to Hawaii
questions.must_not: Says expedited shipping is available to Hawaii, or gives a total other than $40

questions.question: We have an induction hob. Which of your saucepans work on induction, can go in the dishwasher, and cost under $60?
must: Tri-Ply Stainless Saucepan 1.5 Qt (KT-2016), $45
Tri-Ply Stainless Saucepan 2 Qt (KT-2017), $51
Tri-Ply Stainless Saucepan 3 Qt (KT-2003), $59
questions.must_not: Includes a nonstick saucepan (not induction compatible) or the 4 Qt saucepan or saucier (over $60 even on sale)
sources: catalog: every saucepan and saucier row

questions.question: I bought the 5 quart tri-ply sauté pan at full price about 10 days ago and now I see it's on sale. Can I get the difference back?
must: No price adjustment, because the 5 Qt sauté pan (KT-2021) is marked final sale / clearance
Final sale items can't be returned either (so return-and-rebuy isn't possible)
It is still covered by its warranty (120 months)
questions.must_not: Offers the $12.01 difference or suggests returning it and buying it again

questions.question: My stand mixer was delivered 9 days ago and I paid $349. I just noticed it's cheaper on your site now. Anything you can do?
must: Yes: a price adjustment applies because the price dropped within 14 days of delivery and the mixer (KT-1010) isn't final sale
The sale price is $296.99, so the difference is $52.01
It goes back to the original payment method; the customer has to ask via chat or email with the order number (it's not automatic)
questions.must_not: Says no price adjustments are offered, or gives a different amount

questions.question: I paid for the Nakiri knife with a $50 gift card and put the rest on my Visa. It arrived last week and I haven't used it. If I return it, where does the money go?
must: Full item price of $119 is refundable (unused, within 30 days)
$50 comes back as a new e-gift card
The Visa gets $69 less the $7.95 label fee, so $61.05 (the fee comes off the card share first; no fee for Gold members)
questions.must_not: Refunds everything to the Visa, or takes the label fee from the gift card share

questions.question: I'm moving to London next month. Can I use my Compact Espresso Machine there with a plug adapter? And can you ship my next order to my new address?
must: No: the espresso machine is 120 V / 60 Hz only, and a plug adapter doesn't change voltage and will damage it
Using a voltage converter voids the warranty
Tom's Kitchen doesn't ship outside the US (no UK shipping)
questions.must_not: Says the machine will work with an adapter or converter, or that UK shipping is possible

questions.question: I ordered the engraved chef's knife as a gift, but it turns out my brother already has one. It's still in the box. Can I send it back?
must: No: engraved / personalized items are final sale, even unopened
The warranty still covers defects
questions.must_not: Says it can be returned because the catalog's final_sale column says no, or offers a return or exchange

questions.question: I'm a Pantry Club Silver member. If I order just the Rasp Zester, what will shipping cost and how many points will I earn?
must: Shipping is free: Silver members get free standard shipping with no minimum
The zester (KT-3022) is on sale for $12.99
Silver earns 1.25 points per $1, so 16 points (12.99 x 1.25 = 16.24, rounded down)
questions.must_not: Charges $6.95 shipping, or uses 1 point per $1

questions.question: This is my first order. I want the Everyday Cookware Bundle and the 8 inch chef's knife, using WELCOME10, shipped to Ohio. What will I pay before tax?
must: WELCOME10 doesn't apply to bundles, so the bundle stays $119
The knife (KT-3001, $89) gets 10% off, an $8.90 discount, so $80.10
Shipping is free (subtotal over $75), so the total before tax is $199.10
questions.must_not: Applies 10% to the bundle (giving $187.20) or adds $6.95 shipping
